# M3-01 / M3-02 tables (generated by tables.py)

Wrong-commit = wrong commits / all test items, exact two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95 % interval (zero counts: one-sided 95 % upper bound). eWPM from the harness simulated user. McNemar: exact, paired on the per-item wrong-commit indicator vs v4; Holm over the arms of one table. Controls: Paper 1 audit draws (B2T split A only).
